items.name: DDQ section 7
items.note: Composite assets conflict with the report [S3]

after.title: Key judgment — claim wording is supported
after.text: The firm-wide compliance statement follows the required wording in the reviewed report [S1]. This supports the presentation of the claim, but wording alone does not establish that every firm process, composite record and disclosure operated consistently during the covered periods.

after.title: Key judgment — latest year is outside verification
after.text: Verification covers 2015–2024 while the composite report extends through 2025 [S1, S2]. The latest reported year therefore sits outside the stated verification period, so readers should not infer verifier coverage for 2025 from the earlier opinion.

after.title: Key judgment — composite scale conflicts
after.text: The DDQ reports $2.4B of composite assets versus $2.1B in the year-end report [S1, S3]. The $0.3B difference remains unresolved because the records do not provide aligned effective dates or a reconciliation of flows and valuation changes.

after.title: Key judgment — fee basis is incomplete
after.text: The report describes management fees but does not identify the stated performance fee [S1]. This omission limits interpretation of net returns because the reviewed schedule does not establish whether that additional fee applies or how it is reflected.

before.title: Priority findings

items.title: Composite assets conflict
items.detail: The DDQ reports $2.4B while the GIPS Report reports $2.1B [S1, S3].

items.title: Fee schedule incomplete
items.detail: The reviewed fee disclosure omits the performance fee [S1].

before.empty_text: No High, Medium or Low findings were identified.

after.title: Analysis — composite scale is unresolved
after.text: **Observation:** Composite assets differ by $0.3B across two records [S1, S3]. **Why it matters:** Scale changes the context for the presented track record. **Uncertainty:** Effective dates and reconciliation records were not supplied. **What would change the view:** Follow-up request 1 producing a dated reconciliation.

after.title: Analysis — net-return fee basis is incomplete
after.text: **Observation:** One stated performance fee is absent from the schedule [S1]. **Why it matters:** Net-return interpretation depends on a complete fee basis. **Uncertainty:** The supplied report may omit a separately approved schedule. **What would change the view:** Follow-up request 2 producing approved fee records.

before.title: Track-record reliance by evidence area
before.note: Counts reflect the fictional reviewed evidence [S1][S2][S3].

items.q: Provide a dated reconciliation of the $2.4B DDQ and $2.1B report composite assets.
Provide the complete fee schedule, including the performance fee.
Provide the current list of composite descriptions.
